run_curve_fitting_example: run the Theseus minimal example that fits an exponential curve to synthetic observations
generate_data_function: create synthetic x and y data points using the exponential model y_model with configurable num_points
error_fn_residual: compute the residual y - v * exp(x) for use in a Theseus AutoDiffCostFunction
create_theseus_objective: build a Theseus Objective with an AutoDiffCostFunction using GaussNewton optimization and ScaleCostWeight
run_theseus_layer_forward: run a TheseusLayer forward pass with GaussNewton optimizer and implicit backward mode for differentiable optimization
